newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbian telecom privatisation deal postponed.
newsitem.headline: Serbian telecom privatisation deal postponed.

text.p: Serbia's widely-expected sale of part of its state telecommunications company to Italian and Greek companies has been postponed until further notice, a source close to Serbian negotiating team said on Sunday.
"The deal is postponed until some technicalities are finalised. It could be tomorrow, but it could be any other day as well," the source told Reuters but would not elaborate.
Serbia said earlier it would conclude a major foreign investment deal in its Telekom Srbija on Sunday by signing a contract with Stet of Italy and OTE of Greece.
A press release issued by the Serbian information ministry said Prime Minister Mirko Marjanovic would attend the signing ceremony at 1630 GMT.

No official details were released about Serbia's first major privatisation deal, but authoritative sources said Telekom Srbija was expected to sell a 29 percent of its stake to Stet and 20 percent to OTE for a total of around 1.57 billion German marks ($910 million).
